blocks.heading: What is 2s10?
blocks.body: Mitochondrial-targeted tetrapeptide profile for cardiolipin and ATP research. Coze describes SS-31 as a mitochondrial-targeted tetrapeptide that selectively binds cardiolipin in the inner mitochondrial membrane, stabilizes electron transport chain complexes, reduces reactive oxygen species, and supports ATP-synthesis research. SS-31 10mg is mapped to LPPeptide SKU 2S10. Current storefront values use our product data: 10mg x 10 vials /box, $130.00 USD per box. LPPeptide reference specs: 10mg x 10 vials / 50mg x 10 vials.
